title: API keys
hint: Manage service accounts and expiring credentials. Creating or changing credentials requires authentication within the last five minutes.
name: Service account name
readAll: Allow reading every project in this organization
createAll: Allow creating projects in this organization
failed: The request failed. Check your access and sign in again if fresh authentication is required.
secret: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
confirmRevoke: Revoke this key now? Existing integrations using it will lose access.
confirmRotate: Rotate this key now? The old key will stop working immediately.
confirmDeactivate: Deactivate this account and revoke all its keys?
unavailable: The secret may have been issued but its response was lost. Refresh the list and revoke or rotate the key; secrets cannot be retrieved.
